judge.notes: Two has the clearest end-to-end story, strongest hierarchy, polished product UI relationship, and best composition variety while maintaining a cohesive visual system. Three is also coherent and visually distinctive, with a good listen-decide-move narrative, but several supporting labels are very small and its layouts feel slightly less refined. One is clean and consistent, yet comparatively sparse and generic; its diagrams and metrics communicate less substantive information, and some text is too small to support the reading path.
